OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH
Up to 400,000 Shares of Common Stock of
PIEDMONT EXCHANGE CORPORATION
at $4.25 Per Share in Cash

The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Pacific time, on October 30, 2026, unless extended.

Piedmont Exchange Corporation is offering to purchase for cash up to 400,000 shares of its common stock at a purchase price of $4.25 per share, net to the seller in cash.

Odd Lots. Shareholders who own beneficially or of record fewer than 100 Shares and who validly tender all of those Shares will have their Shares accepted for purchase before proration of the Shares tendered by other shareholders; provided, however, that this odd lot preference will not apply, and all tendered Shares will be subject to proration, if the purchase of Shares pursuant to this preference would result in the Shares being held of record by fewer than 300 persons. Partial tenders do not qualify.

Shares may be withdrawn at any time prior to the Expiration Date.
